hypotheses.justification: Lean can already find this instance from Mathlib, so the binder is redundant. Here `J : Type v` is a `SmallCategory`, so its morphisms also live in `Type v`, and `F : J ⥤ TopCat.{max v u}`. Mathlib provides `TopCat.topCat_hasLimitsOfSize [UnivLE.{v, u}] : HasLimitsOfSize.{w, v} TopCat.{u}` (Mathlib/Topology/Category/TopCat/Limits/Basic.lean:173). The condition `UnivLE.{v, max v u}` is found automatically through `univLE_of_max` and `UnivLE.self` (Mathlib/Basic/UnivLE.lean:67-77, where `example : UnivLE.{v, max v u} := inferInstance` is checked explicitly). The usual instance chain from `HasLimitsOfSize` to `HasLimitsOfShape J` to `HasLimit F` then supplies `HasLimit F`. So after deleting the binder, `limit.π F i` still elaborates using this global instance. The statement stays true, and the proof is unchanged: `limitCylinder_subset_iff_eventually F i hX hmap (limit.cone F) (limit.isLimit F) U V hUopen hUcompact hVopen` holds for any `HasLimit F` instance, because the earlier theorem works for an arbitrary limit cone `C` with `IsLimit C`.
